items.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
items.summary: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.

items.title: Airtel overtakes HDFC Bank to become India's most valuable brand: Report
items.summary: Airtel's brand value rises 5% to $43.2 billion, marking the first time a telecom company has claimed the top spot since the rankings began in 2014

items.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.

items.title: Protesters Arrested Outside Nasdaq as Activists Oppose Anthropic IPO Over AI Bubble Risks
items.summary: At least four people were arrested outside Nasdaq during Anthropic’s historic IPO, as protesters warned that AI valuations could leave retirement savers exposed to a potential market crash and broader economic losses.
